belief_update: I think I'm broken in a way that can't be fixed, and that makes me someone people can't really trust. I believe if they knew how I still feel at night, they'd see me as weak and unreliable, someone who's not up to the job. I keep my pain hidden because talking about it feels like admitting I'm not as strong as I used to be. I don't let anyone see how much I struggle, not even my sister, because I'm afraid they'd stop seeing me as the kind of person who should be in charge. I don't think asking for help would make things better — I think it would just prove I'm not the same as the others who got through it. I keep my distance because I don't want to be a burden or a risk to anyone. I don't know if any of this changes who I really am, but I know it's the thing I carry every day.
